prompt_rules: One independent image per view. Never emit MOSS Layout JSON, Picture tokens, BREAK tokens, or sheet-level multi-view instructions.
Manual appearance remains unchanged. Image tags are explicitly scoped by the linked appearance profile; no image adapter or LLM is used.
Use short Anima-style tags followed by two short view instructions where useful; user part text is preserved verbatim.
Count/solo subject tags are used for portraits and full figures only; do not add person tags or global subject notes to garments, hands, or feet.
Do not invent details on unseen rear surfaces; preserve explicit rear-view notes and mark inferred surfaces in documentation.
User notes may conflict semantically with structural instructions; do not claim arbitrary text can be filtered or guaranteed overridden.
White/gray background is a generation instruction plus the compositor canvas; it is not automatic subject segmentation.
No automatic retries, inferred outfit fabrication, special per-character hardcoding, or prompt truncation.

styles.anime: Anime illustration with controlled linework and cel shading.
styles.photo: Photographic rendering with realistic surface textures and soft, even studio light.
styles.realistic_painting: Realistic painted forms with readable material rendering.
styles.semi_realistic_anime: Anime-derived features with softly modeled, semi-realistic shading.
styles.oil_painting: Oil-painted rendering with visible, controlled brushwork.
styles.watercolor: Watercolor pigment washes with clearly defined silhouettes.
styles.gouache: Opaque gouache color shapes with readable contours.
styles.colored_pencil: Colored-pencil rendering with visible strokes and clearly defined forms.
styles.3d: Three-dimensional rendered surfaces with coherent materials and soft studio lighting.
